title: The Bundesrat corpus: A dataset of political discourse in the German Federal Council
abstract: arXiv:2611.33173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Bundesrat is Germany's second legislative chamber and a constitutional veto player within its political system. The members of the Bundesrat are delegates of state governments. Tracing the political discourse in the Bundesrat is challenging as it has a limited machine-readable corpus available. To address this issue, we present a speaker-attributed corpus of 1,067 Bundesrat plenary sessions from the chamber's first session on 7 September 1949 to 10 July 2026. In this period, a total of 53,362 speeches by 2,473 individuals were delivered in the chamber, including written statements. Each speech includes a speech ID, the full German text, the speaker's name, the date and location of the session, the federal state that the speaker represents, the speaker's role (if applicable), the type of contribution, and the speaker's gender. translated_title: 联邦参议院语料库：德国联邦参议院政治话语数据集
translated_abstract: 联邦参议院是德国的第二立法机构，也是其政治体制中拥有宪法否决权的重要参与者。联邦参议院的成员由各州政府的代表组成。由于可用的机器可读语料库有限，追踪联邦参议院的政治话语一直具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个带有发言人标注的语料库，涵盖从1949年9月7日首次会议到2026年7月10日的1,067次联邦参议院全体会议。在此期间，共有2,473人在该机构发表了53,362次演讲，其中包括书面声明。每次演讲都包含演讲ID、完整的德语文本、发言人姓名、会议日期和地点、发言人所代表的联邦州、发言人角色（如适用）、发言类型以及发言人性别。该数据集为计算政治科学、立法研究等领域的跨学科研究提供了机会。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个涵盖1949年至2026年德国联邦参议院1,067次全体会议、包含53,362篇发言人标注演讲的机器可读语料库，为计算政治学等跨学科研究提供了宝贵的数据资源。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a speaker-attributed machine-readable corpus of 1,067 Bundesrat plenary sessions from 1949 to 2026, containing 53,362 speeches, enabling interdisciplinary research in computational political science.
